[b]22nd July 2025[/b]

Hydronia has begun deploying a further 200,000 troops to the BR Bob. This deployment will, like the last one, consist of 20,000 engineers to help build up the BR bobs defence capabilities.

Back home, missile defence systems across the country have been activated, preparing for a technocratic strike at any moment. The government has also begun investing a significant amount of money into weapons research, attempting to find a way to counter the kaiserreichs hypersonic capabilities.

With regards to the suspended uranium shipments to Dhornaper, the government had contacted the new Dhora government and told them that shipments will be resumed on the condition that the Dhora do not trade with the EDU. The Hydronian government knows that this war will not stay within the borders of THEP and EDU, so it wishes to expand its sphere of influence throughout the globe.
